rules: Foundation features are feat-0NN. Per-unit migration features are feat-1NN and up.
A migration feature must list the inventory unit ids it covers in sourceUnits.
sourceHashes records each unit's inventory sourceHash at spec time; coverage-check flags drift.
status=done requires evidence: {command, summary, outputDigest, date} and checker approval.

features.name: TimesTen logic inventory extraction
features.description: Extract the TimesTen logic inventory through the read-only TimesTen MCP server (see inventory/sources.yaml; query catalog in tools/extract-inventory.sql), transform results into inventory/inventory.json with sourceHash per unit. See docs/01-logic-inventory.md.

features.name: Golden-master capture rig
features.description: Rig that executes captured or synthesized vectors against reference TimesTen via the MCP server with an injected/recorded clock, and records inputs plus full observable outputs (return values, OUT params, row deltas, errors) as vectors/<unit-id>/*.jsonl. MCP is capture-only: the parity runner replays stored vectors offline. See docs/02-parity-testing.md. Real-traffic vectors are mined from CERTIFIED tapes only (feat-008); synthesized capture fills branches with no observed traffic.

features.name: Aeron Cluster service skeleton
features.description: ClusteredService skeleton: SBE codecs, command dispatch, state-hash function, snapshot round-trip test, determinism replay test (same message sequence twice => identical state hash). Must pass tools/check-determinism.sh.

features.name: Parity runner
features.description: Test runner that replays golden-master vectors against the new service and compares outputs field-by-field per the comparison rules in docs/02-parity-testing.md (fixed-point scale, NULL mapping, order-insensitive sets, injected clock).

features.name: Generate per-unit migration features
features.description: For every unit in inventory/inventory.json, add a feat-1NN entry with sourceUnits and dependencies derived from the unit call graph (leaf utilities first). After this, node tools/coverage-check.mjs must report zero unmapped units.

features.name: Capture coverage matrix
features.description: Map every externally invokable inventory unit to an input capture source (FIX/OMS/audit logs, interceptor); report field gaps vs specs. Violations reported alongside coverage-check. See docs/05-capture-replay.md.

features.name: Capture pipeline: normalizers + write-aside interceptor
features.description: Generate parsers normalizing every obtainable source into the canonical envelope. Zero-PROD-access mode (docs/05): sources are existing exported copies (central log platform, compliance archive, DBA backup copies, back-office EOD reports) requested per D-009 — never PROD itself. Write-aside interceptor is OPTIONAL (only if the PROD-owning team deploys it); units with insufficient log fields fall back to synthesized capture and are marked synthesized-only in the coverage matrix. Deterministic masking per D-008.

features.name: Tape certification rig
features.description: Nightly automatic: replay tape D into a staging copy of OLD TimesTen restored from a D-1 backup copy obtained via D-009 (UAT/SIT instance acceptable), reconcile EOD state against PROD actual day-D archives field-by-field. Tape is certified only on zero-diff; only certified tapes feed vectors/replays/parity evidence.

features.name: Capture-watch loop
features.description: Automated monitor loop: drop counters, unparsed ratio, schema drift, certification failures. Auto-patches mechanical parser issues (traced); semantic ambiguities become proposed docs/04 decisions. Runs on the maker-checker machinery.
